supporting_observations.claim: At 13:38:05 UTC, a Kerberos service-ticket event records raj.patel, originating from 10.51.10.23 (WS-RPATEL-01 per the asset context), requesting a ticket for WS-ARUIZ-01$.
At 13:40:35 UTC, WS-ARUIZ-01 made a proxy connection to download.windowsupdate.com identifying as Windows Update Agent; the associated connection transferred about 38.8 MB from the server.

The administrator-related ticket and Windows Update traffic are consistent with the scheduled workstation patching context, but the records do not establish that either caused the reported PowerShell window.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec and Sysmon collection for WS-ARUIZ-01 was unavailable from 13:25 to 14:20 UTC due to a log collection outage; the reported 13:40 activity falls within that gap.
The available proxy and network records show connections and traffic, not the process that initiated them or whether a PowerShell window appeared.
claims_not_established: Whether PowerShell ran on WS-ARUIZ-01 around 13:40 UTC, and, if so, its command line, parent process, user, or purpose.
Whether the 13:38 administrator-related ticket led to a remote session or execution on WS-ARUIZ-01.
Whether the Windows Update traffic was initiated by the scheduled patching activity or was independent of it.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover endpoint process creation and EDR telemetry for WS-ARUIZ-01 around 13:40 UTC, including Sysmon Event 1, Security Event 4688, and PowerShell operational logs if available.
Review WS-RPATEL-01 and FILE-PIN-01 logs for evidence of the patch script being accessed or executed against WS-ARUIZ-01 at the relevant time.
Ask ana.ruiz whether the PowerShell window coincided with a patch or update and obtain any relevant endpoint or support records.
unrelated_findings: WS-ARUIZ-01 made repeated TLS connections to WS-TWEBER-01 on port 443; the available records identify the destination but not the application or purpose. Review separately.

The proxy records show WS-ARUIZ-01 accessing Google Calendar and the AWS website/AWS console, services not listed among approved software and services in the supplied context. Review separately; these records do not establish that this activity is related to the reported PowerShell window.
